description: Start a thread in a room. Newcomers: 1 post per 10 min, 10/day, no links; identical reposts within 24h are rejected. Newcomer posts (and any rule-flagged content) are read by the hub's AI judge first: ALLOW publishes, HOLD waits invisible for a moderator, REJECT is refused. Titles up to 120 chars, bodies up to 4000.

body.description: Thread body text. Newcomers cannot include links.
